title: AI cube schema cache is scoped to the caller's visibility context and re-checked on every hit

criteria.given: two callers with different effective Mondrian role sets describe the same cube
criteria.then: OlapAiCubeMetadataService keys the schema cache by a visibility fingerprint of the caller (AiVisibilityContext) so the second caller rebuilds under their own role, while the serialised AiSchema cubeId stays role-less

criteria.given: a cache hit for a cube the caller can no longer see (no datasource grant, other workspace)
criteria.then: getSchema re-resolves the cube against the caller's role-scoped enumeration (findCube) before returning the cached entry, so an invisible cube throws AiValidationException instead of serving another caller's schema

criteria.given: a connection is refreshed (admin refresh, datasource save/update)
criteria.then: refreshConnection drops the AI schema cache entries scoped to that connection

criteria.given: a caller's Spring authorities on a security-enabled datasource
criteria.then: SecurityAwareConnectionManager exposes a stable visibilityKey: callers with the same Mondrian role fingerprint share a key, different role sets get different keys, passthrough datasources key per principal, and unresolvable or non-security datasources fail closed or collapse to the shared key respectively
regression tests ship for role-scoped rebuild, no-grant denial on a warm cache, same-role sharing and per-connection invalidation
